name: α-L-fucoside to oxaloacetate
summary: A 8-step route from α-L-fucoside to oxaloacetate(2−), ingested from Rhea. Every step is curated by Rhea and independently verified here to balance in mass and charge.

reactions.name: alpha-L-fucosidase
reactions.equation: an alpha-L-fucoside + H2O = L-fucose + an alcohol

reactions.name: fusarinine-C ornithinesterase
reactions.equation: an N(5)-acyl-L-ornithine ester + H2O = an N(5)-acyl-L-ornithine + an alcohol + H(+)

reactions.name: NADH-dependent peroxiredoxin
reactions.equation: a hydroperoxide + NADH + H(+) = an alcohol + NAD(+) + H2O

reactions.name: L-aspartate + O2 + H2O = oxaloacetate + H2O2 + NH4(+)
reactions.equation: L-aspartate + O2 + H2O = oxaloacetate + H2O2 + NH4(+)
